analytic.title: Comprehensive metadata for the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) corpus included in ESGenius. The collection spans 2020-2023 and comprises 11 documents totaling 60 MB across 728 pages, yielding 123 benchmark questions. The materials include core guidance documents on implementation, metrics, targets, scenario analysis and risk management, a complete five-part workshop series covering fundamentals through metrics, and the 2023 status report.
